q: Bring 3 Taillasher Eggs to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.
Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.
Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
Bring the head of Targorr the Dread to Guard Berton in Lakeshire.
Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
Bring pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter II.
Bring Bartolo Ginsetti of Southshore a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak, Fine Thread and 10 clumps of Yeti Fur.
Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.
Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.
Bring Ol' Sooty's head to Vyrin Swiftwind at the Farstrider Lodge.
Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
Bring Razorflank's Medallion to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.
Bring Razorflank's Heart to Auld Stonespire in Thunder Bluff.
Captain Steelgut in Faldir's Cove wants you to kill 10 Daggerspine Raiders and 3 Daggerspine Sorceresses.
Bring 5 Scaber Stalks and 1 Death Cap to Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine.
Get 7 pieces of Scrap Metal for Sigrun.
Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek at the Den.
Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
Bring 10 Singing Blue Crystals to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
Acquire a Black Drake's Heart for Sigrun Ironhew.
Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth wants you to collect the Gargantuan Tumor from Oakenscowl.
Bring Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
Bring 6 Mathystra Relics to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.
Bring Tharil'zun's Head to Marshal Marris in Redridge.
Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.
Bring 60 Bristleback Quilboar Tusks to Mankrik at the Crossroads.
Travel to the Den on Stonetalon Peak. Using the Gatekeeper's Key, obtain the druids' hidden items. Use these items to open the Talon Den Hoard.
Find an Unrefined Ore Sample on a Gravelsnout Digger or Surveyor and bring it to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Maintain your Magram reputation, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

Kill the group of Shadow Silk Poachers that wander the Searing Gorge. Nilith has reason to believe that there are five of them that need to be exterminated. Return to Nilith in the Searing Gorge when this task is complete.
Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.
Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village wants you to destroy 5 Eggs of Onyxia.
Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.
Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.
Kill Geltharis and return the Branch of Cenarius to Illiyana at Forest Song.
Speak to Eridan again in a moment.
Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
Bring the Stolen Silver to Gazrog in the Crossroads.
Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
Collect 6 Fine Crab Chunks for Gubber Blump in Auberdine.
Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.
Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.
Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Find Guard Roberts and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.
Find Mountaineer Dolf and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos.
Oben Rageclaw wants you to kill his soulless body, and then use the Voodoo Charm.
Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Mantle
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
Do a flex emote at Innkeeper Gryshka, and in exchange you'll receive Orgrimmar Nougat!
Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

Bring 6 Oils of Immolation, 5 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 10 Dense Blasting Powder to Arcanist Nozzlespring near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard, 1 Large Radiant Shard and 1 Huge Emerald to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

Bring 8 Rugged Armor Kits and 8 Heavy Armor Kits to Janela Stouthammer at the Ironforge Brigade Outpost near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.
Bring 2 Moonsteel Broadswords to Janela Stouthammer at the Ironforge Brigade Outpost outside of Hive'Zora. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Baked Salmon to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.
Find Metzen the Reindeer. Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.
Find Metzen the Reindeer. Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.
Bring 1 Deeprock Salt and 5 gold coins to any Holly Preserver machine, upon which you will receive 5 Preserved Holly.
Bring 1 Deeprock Salt and 5 gold coins to the Holly Preserver machine, upon which you will receive 5 Preserved Holly.
Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of War, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Gold Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

Bring the the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Give Deliana your Shadowcraft Cap and Shadowcraft Tunic.
Give Mokvar your Shadowcraft Cap and Shadowcraft Tunic.
Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Elements, Kilt of Elements and Pauldrons of Elements.
Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.

Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Legguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 3 Arcanite Bars and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.
Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Gloves if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gloves, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps and 4 Mooncloth.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to bring her 1 Abyssal Scepter. You must also be Honored with the Cenarion Circle.
